The ACM Hackathon is an intensive, collaborative coding event where students gather to design, build, and present innovative software or hardware projects from scratch. Working individually or in small teams, participants brainstorm creative solutions, write code, and debug applications within a set timeframe. The Music Club Jam is a collaborative workshop and practice session focused on guitar performance, group improvisation, and musical experimentation. Participants will engage in guided and open jam sessions featuring both acoustic and electric guitars across a variety of genres, including rock, blues, pop, and indie. Activities include practicing rhythm and lead techniques, sharing chord progressions, breaking down song structures, and experimenting with group arrangements.
